newsitem.title: CHINA: Coca Cola launches new soft drink in China.
newsitem.headline: Coca Cola launches new soft drink in China.

text.p: The Coca-Cola Company on Friday launched a new fizzy soft drink called Smart that it says is the first carbonated drink designed by an international company specifically for the Chinese market.

Smart, aimed at the enormous youth market in China, was colourfully packaged in tins and bottles, and would be available in five flavours -- apple, mandarin orange, coconut, peach and watermelon, a company statement said.
Smart would satisfy a need for high-quality carbonated soft drinks in the fast-growing China market, the executive vice president of Coca-Cola China Ltd, Steve Chan, was quoted as saying.
The Smart trademark belonged to the Tianjin Jin-Mei Beverage Co Ltd, a joint venture between Coca-Cola and the China National Council of Light Industry, the statement said.
Coca-Cola's Tian Yu Di trademark, acquired by China in 1996, would be transferred to Tianjin Jin-Mei Beverage, it said.
Tian Yu Di was introduced in 1996 to satisfy the growing non-carbonated beverage market, and included five fruit juice drinks and a mineral water now available in nine cities in China.
Smart would be packaged in 355 millilitre cans and 1.25 litre bottles, available from Friday in Beijing, Dalian and Wuhan, the statement said.
